neighbours.label: the opening of a stated fact right after the text announces facts or points to come (a 'things to know about X' list item, '(1)' of announced notes, 'I do know that…')
fire:
Eight things you probably didn't know about Charles Darwin:
- He married his cousin Emma in 1839.

Here are six facts every owner should know about greyhounds:
1. They sleep up to eighteen hours a day.
Two remarks before we go on: (1) the sample was small, and (2) the survey was voluntary.
I can't tell you who wrote it, but I do know that the letter is authentic.

Some things you may not know about honey bees:
- A queen can lay two thousand eggs a day.
We won't reveal the ending, but we will say that the last chapter is a surprise.

Five things to remember about your new teenager:
- Your son will copy what you do, not what you say.
Key points from the meeting include the following: 1) budgets are frozen until June.
quiet: Charles Darwin married his cousin Emma in 1839 and settled in Kent.
Our greyhounds sleep up to eighteen hours a day and love the sofa.
The sample was small and the survey was voluntary, so we ran it twice.
Somebody wrote the letter in a hurry and mailed it the same night.

Packing list for the trip:
- two wool sweaters and a rain jacket
A queen can lay two thousand eggs a day while the workers feed her.
The last chapter is a surprise, and the ending is sad.
Budgets are frozen until June because sales fell in the spring.

short: onset of an announced fact / list point
notes: No single token (card: '-', ' are', ' that', ' is', ')' ). look: list items after 'Thirteen things you may not know about…', 'Three notes in passing: (1)', 'the only things I knew were that', 'I do want to say that'.
